Toasted Rice Tea

A simple drink with a nutty taste. This recipe makes two cups for a quiet afternoon, and it needs nothing more than rice and water from your kitchen.

Ingredients

  • 3 tablespoons white rice
  • 2 cups water

Steps

  1. Toast the rice in a dry pan until golden.
  2. Pour hot water over it.
  3. Steep for five minutes and strain.
